digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Agent-driven development loop lacks aggregation layer and durable metric persistence; no way to trend signals like env-diagnosis time, bug provenance, or code-health movement over time.

Three Tier-C blindspots leave no structural trace in the event store today: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused this bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky).

Blamed `caused_by` edges must be auto-derived from pre-fix state (parent of fixing commit) over the bug's file_impact, skipped when blame cannot resolve a single commit, and written directly to bypass closed-source guards.
Required bug-close argument must swap from free-text `--reason` to bounded `--class` enum (persisted on STATUS event) without increasing total required-argument count from 1 to 2.
Metrics snapshots must be git-tracked at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` (not gitignored `reports/`) so going-forward series survives sync.

Every registered metric in `rebar metrics --since <date> --until <date> --output json` must be present with either a value or structured `unavailable` reason, never absent; backfilled values are labeled `source=backfill_classified` and never aggregated into authoritative structural series.
